decision: Ordinary unknown words receive lightweight dictionary and thesaurus leaves, not automatic full learning trees.
shipped: floating built-in dictionary and thesaurus dock
routingRule: Define the word in the lexicon. Grow a canonical tree only when the concept warrants history, evidence, competing claims, or meaningful branches.
truthBoundary: A missing dictionary entry creates a lexical review receipt; it does not create an encyclopedia topic or an invented definition.
